design_decision.reason: Two-machine Mouse Without Borders desync is too under-specified to scope a fix without targeted environment evidence.

confidence.rationale: The report is real enough to keep, but the next bounded step is still evidence gathering.

linked_work.title: Mouse Without Borders: failed clipboard transfer permanently kills the clipboard listener; later copies desync the main channel and drop the whole connection

judgment.rationale: The issue proves recurring two-machine desync, but it still does not identify which side disconnects first or whether clipboard/file transfer is the trigger.
evidence: The reporter says the session desynchronizes again after a few minutes.
Admin mode and service mode were already tried.
Related open issue #49147 ties clipboard transfer to later MWB desync.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the exact two-machine setup, trigger, and a fresh desync-time bug report.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys fix may apply, but the public report does not yet identify the failing channel.

issue_context.summary: Mouse Without Borders loses sync between two PCs after a few minutes, and restarting PowerToys only temporarily restores the connection.
known_information: Admin mode and service mode were both tried.
The earlier uploaded ZIP could not be analyzed automatically.
inferences: The defect is likely in connection maintenance or a dependent channel rather than in a single toggle state.
Clipboard or file transfer may be a useful discriminator because of related issue #49147.
issue_context.analysis: Because MWB needs two physical machines, the smallest useful next step is a targeted reporter evidence request rather than a speculative network fix.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full issue body and automated triage comment.
Reviewed local MWB reconnect and disconnect logging paths.

information_gaps.information: Which machine loses control first and whether clipboard/file transfer or another specific action triggers the desync.
information_gaps.why_needed: This separates a general reconnect failure from a side-channel trigger already seen in related issues.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with a short numbered description of what each machine was doing just before the desync and which direction of control stopped first.

information_gaps.information: A fresh bug report from the machine where desync appears first, and the paired machine too if practical.
information_gaps.why_needed: The logs need to capture the live disconnect and reconnect attempt.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reproduce once and add a comment containing /bugreport immediately afterward on the affected machine; if possible collect one from the paired machine too.

comment.body:
Thanks for confirming that the Mouse Without Borders session desynchronizes again after only a few minutes even when you try admin mode and service mode. Please provide:

1. Which machine loses control first, whether the break follows a clipboard or file transfer or another specific action, and what each machine was doing just before the desync.
2. A fresh bug report from the machine where the desync appears first: reproduce the problem once and add a comment containing "/bugreport" immediately afterward on that machine. If practical, collect one from the paired machine too.
